name: 18660 · Wapwallopen, PA
findings: ZIP 18660 (Wapwallopen) has 20 nonprofit organizations. 11 of them (55%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 18660 (Wapwallopen) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 18660 (Wapwallopen) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 4.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 35% of all organizations here have no identified type.
